description: Barov Family Fortune Level 60 Venture to the Scholomance and recover the Barov family fortune. Four deeds make up this fortune: The Deed to Caer Darrow; The Deed to Brill; The Deed to Tarren Mill; and The Deed to Southshore. Return to Weldon Barov when you have completed this task. Requirements: - The Deed to Brill - The Deed to Caer Darrow - The Deed to Southshore - The Deed to Tarren Mill
name: Barov Family Fortune
